headline: EXCLUSIVE: Father of AGI Warns Investors May Be Mispricing Meta's AI Moat
summary: Investors are overestimating Meta's AI moat as the industry shifts from compute-driven scaling to algorithmic innovation, Ben Goertzel says.

headline: Micron and 15 Other Stocks To Play The AI Buildout Race: They Are Still 20% Below Highs
summary: Bank of America screened its AI baskets for Buy-rated stocks down over 20% from highs. Micron carries the widest gap to target.
